part.text: Now writing and compiling a small test:<|mask_end|>

All 24 tests pass, compiles clean with `gcc -std=c11 -Wall -Werror`. Here's what was implemented in `ringbuf.c`:

| Function | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `rb_create` | Allocates buffer + ringbuf struct; rejects capacity=0 |
| `rb_destroy` | Frees both buf and struct; NULL-safe |
| `rb_write` | Wraps head pointer, stores up to free space (truncates if too large) |
| `rb_read` | Wraps tail pointer, returns oldest bytes first |
| `rb_peek` | Same as read but doesn't advance tail or change size |
| `rb_size` / `rb_capacity` | Return current bytes / total capacity; NULL-safe |
| `rb_clear` | Resets head, tail, size to zero |
